text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The process of the extension of state administration to UNITA-held areas resumed on Wednesday in Huambo province. The Angolan government flag was raisd over the towns of Vila Nova, Londuimbali, Tchipipa and Alta Hama in ceremoneis attended by representatives of the government, UNITA and the U.N.

There were demonstrations and protests when the flag was raised in the towns where UNITA has long maintained that the national flag should be changed since it bares a close resemblance to the flag of the ruling MPLA.

- Angolan President Jose Eduard dos Santos met on Wednesday with six members of the House of Representatives. The meeting centered around discussions of the on-going peace process and the extension of state administration.
